correctness.rationale: Integer compositions by block sums reduce L_a(q) to weights binom(r+a-1,a-1) under pairwise sum constraints. Splitting z^{r1+r2+r3-min r}/(1-z) yields the exact minimum-layer generating identity F_a=1/(1-z)^{3a+1}+sum_{t>=1}z^{2t}A_{a,t}(z)^3. The top t-degree 3a-3 coefficient is ((a-1)!)^-3(1-z)^-3 and yields a strictly nonzero pole at z=-1 of order 3a-2 with principal coefficient (3a-3)!/(2^{3a+1}((a-1)!)³), excluding period collapse. A full-dimensional Ehrhart pole at z=1 has order 3a+1. Independent height enumeration and constituent interpolation at a=2,3 recover the claimed leading alternating coefficients 1/128 and 1/8192. This is a valid unrestricted analytic proof, not an inference from finite checks.
residual_risks: Independent bounded numerical tests corroborate but do not replace the analytic/finite-exhaustive proof as detailed.
